decisions.reason: The request for a complete package with _24 filenames does not change legacy copy-paste behavior or resolve its existing ambiguity.
Including all templates in a versioned package does not change their required bullet size, alignment, color, or visual design.
The package and filename-version request does not change the required Tab-based list hierarchy or resolve the supported-interaction ambiguity.
The source changes only package completeness and filename versioning; interactive-field help-label behavior remains unchanged.
The complete-package request does not modify numbered-list alignment behavior.
The source does not change pasted-table or column-containment requirements and does not resolve their existing feasibility conflict.
Package versioning and completeness do not change the templates' default Word language configuration.
The request to package and rename all template files does not change any named-style typography attributes.
The source does not alter Danish style names, field labels, or placeholder text.
The complete-package and filename-version decision does not alter the allowed theme color palette.
The source does not change the established Board Meeting row-insertion workflow.
The package request does not change date-picker behavior, display format, or template scope.
